_comment: UNVERIFIED AFTER RENAME (2026-08-07). Product 9PLRSZZMFPJH was reserved as 'Hearth'; its Partner Center package identity was ToledoTechnologies.Hearth. A package whose identity does not match the reservation will be rejected at submission.
